data.title: Can Machine Learning Beat Elo in Professional League of Legends?
data.research_question: Does a logistic regression with pre-game features predict single-game outcomes better than an Elo benchmark, in terms of probability accuracy (Brier score, log loss) on a later, untouched test period?

data.title: Competitive Balance in Professional League of Legends
data.research_question: How unequal are regular-season results within leagues, and has balance changed over time?

data.title: The Evolution of Team Performance in Professional League of Legends
data.research_question: How persistent is team strength from split to split, how has the spread of team performance changed across seasons, and which teams were consistently strong?

data.title: The Concentration of Tournament Success
data.research_question: How concentrated are league titles among teams?
